data.name: Emberion
data.detailed_description:
== ABOUT THIS GAME ==

Emberion is an intense action survival roguelike where you fight endless waves of enemies in the cursed Ashen Ruins. Master powerful spells, unlock legendary heroes, and see how long you can survive. Every run is different, every death makes you stronger.

== KEY FEATURES ==

• AUTO-ATTACK COMBAT - Focus on positioning and strategy, not button mashing

• MULTIPLE HEROES - Unlock and master the Battle Mage, Sorcerer, and Warlock

• POWERFUL SPELLS - Lightning bolts, spectral skulls, flame slashes, and more

• PROGRESSIVE DIFFICULTY - Each wave gets harder, bosses appear every 10 minutes

• PERMANENT UPGRADES - Spend gold earned in runs to permanently strengthen your hero

• STEAM LEADERBOARDS - Compete globally for the longest survival time

• ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY - No two runs are the same

== GAMEPLAY ==

Start each run weak, but grow stronger as you survive. Collect experience to level up and choose powerful upgrades. Earn gold to spend on permanent stat boosts back in the Sanctuary. Face increasingly difficult enemies and epic boss battles. How long can you survive?

== HEROES ==

• BATTLE MAGE - Balanced warrior-mage hybrid

• SORCERER - Master of arcane magic

• WARLOCK - Dark magic specialist

Each hero has unique abilities and playstyles. Unlock them all and find your favorite!

== FUTURE UPDATES ==

Emberion is actively being developed with regular content updates planned:

• NEW HEROES - More heroes coming in future patches

• NEW MAPS - Additional areas to explore and survive in

• ACHIEVEMENT SYSTEM - Unlock achievements as you progress

• MORE CONTENT - New spells, enemies, bosses, and features

== Social ==

Join our community to stay updated on the latest developments!

== SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS ==

Requires Windows 10 or later. See store page for full system requirements.

data.short_description: Survive endless waves of enemies in this action-packed roguelike. Master powerful spells, unlock heroes, and compete on Steam leaderboards. How long can you last?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (or Windows 11)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Emberion contains fantasy violence in a cartoon-style setting. Players fight against fantasy enemies (skeletons, orcs, magical creatures) using spells and melee attacks. The violence is stylized and non-realistic - enemies disappear when defeated without gore or blood. There is no realistic violence, sexual content, or mature themes. Suitable for players comfortable with fantasy action games.
